d.ko: Our Brief Eternity is a visual novel in which you play as Lin Xiaocou, an ordinary office worker whose quiet life is turned upside down when two girls from another world unexpectedly move in. Amid the warmth, comedy, and chaos of everyday life together, can you find a happy ending for everyone?

d.zh: 《永恒与星辰与日常》是一款文字冒险类游戏。你将扮演名为林小凑的平凡上班族，与两位意外闯入家中的异世界少女展开同居生活。在这段轻松欢乐的日常中，能否寻得属于每个人的幸福？
